artboardPolicy: Full document height remains visible. Do not crop artboards to 1080.

typography.verticalAlignment: Use line-height and layout alignment; do not trim glyphs.

responsiveScope: Only 1920-wide designs are approved here; smaller-width reflow requires a separate design decision.
assetsPolicy: Keep original SVG geometry and raster image proportions. The asset references list points to Figma nodes; raw media files were not exported in this task.
themePolicy: P19 component masters are independent. Existing token collections and aliases stay shared.
